notes: Awarded each time the Damage Ranking is reset. Each pack contains 1 of the following cards:

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card, Skill Chip and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but Gold can be obtained any number of times. On January 16, 2021 (September 3, 2020 during the first run), Cubic Beacons were made available in the Card Trader EX's stock.
The following mission was added on November 27, 2020.
